**Position**

IT Engineer / IT Systems Administrator

**Department**

Information Technology

**Reports To**

Head – IT

**Location**

Delhi Office

**Experience**

3–7 Years

Full Time

**2. Job Purpose**

The IT Engineer will be responsible for the **day-to-day management, availability, security and support of the company's IT infrastructure and business applications**.

The role will manage **systems, networks, servers, user accounts, access rights, security, backups, IT assets and end-user support**, while also providing first-level support and coordination for the company's **ERP system**.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A. IT Infrastructure, System & Network Administration**

· Manage and maintain desktops, laptops, servers, printers, storage and other IT equipment.

· Install, configure and maintain operating systems and business applications.

· Maintain IT asset, software licence, warranty and support records.

· Manage LAN/WAN, Wi-Fi, Internet and VPN connectivity.

· Configure and troubleshoot switches, routers, firewalls, DNS, DHCP and IP addressing.

**B. User & Access Management**

· Create, modify and disable user accounts and system access.

· Control access to network folders, email, ERP and applications based on approved roles & authorization.

**C. ERP Support & Administration**

· Act as the internal IT coordinator for the ERP; administer users, roles and access permissions.

· Coordinate with the ERP implementation/support partner for issues, configuration, reports, integrations and upgrades.

· **Knowledge of Odoo ERP or another manufacturing ERP is preferred.**

**D. Manufacturing & Engineering Systems**

· Provide IT support to Engineering, Production, Stores, Maintenance and Quality.

· Coordinate IT requirements for **CAD, PDM/PLM, document management and other engineering applications**, where applicable.

· Support integration and connectivity between ERP and other business/engineering systems.

**E. Security & Backup**

· Implement and monitor basic IT security controls.

· Ensure regular backup of critical ERP, engineering and business data.

· Maintain basic disaster recovery procedures.

· Promote employee awareness of phishing, passwords, malware and data security.

**4. Required Technical Skills**

**Essential**

* Windows desktop and server administration.
* LAN/WAN and network troubleshooting.
* IT asset management
* User account and access management.
* Hardware and software troubleshooting.

**ERP & other Skills**

* Understanding of ERP concepts and business processes.
* ERP user and role administration.
* Ability to coordinate with ERP implementation/support partners.

· CAD/PDM/PLM systems.

* **Odoo ERP experience is an advantage.**

**5. Educational Qualification & Experience**

**Qualification:**

· Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Electronics or equivalent.

**Experience:**

· 3–7 years of relevant experience in IT infrastructure, system administration and user support.

· Should be capable of working independently and managing day-to-day IT operations.

· Experience supporting **50–100 users** preferred.

· Experience in a **manufacturing organization** is an advantage.

**6. Key Competencies**

· Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

· Good understanding of IT infrastructure and networking.

· User and access management discipline.

· ERP/application support capability.

· Good communication and vendor coordination skills.

· Ability to work independently with minimum supervision.

**7. Overall Responsibility**

The IT Engineer will be the **primary operational IT support resource** for the organization and will ensure that the company's IT infrastructure, network, user access, cybersecurity, backups and ERP environment remain reliable and secure.

The position is expected to work as a **hands-on IT professional and internal system coordinator**, while engaging external specialists/vendors for advanced ERP, cybersecurity, infrastructure or application requirements.

**Key focus areas:**

**IT Infrastructure → Networking → User Access → Cybersecurity → ERP Support → Manufacturing/Engineering Systems → Vendor Management**

Front Desk → Clinic Manager → Operations leadership

Most dentists finish BDS and face two tiring paths: years of underpaid clinical practice, or an expensive MDS. There's a third path most never hear about — **the business of dentistry** — and it's where the real long-term money and leadership sit.

* **Premium brand, premium patients.** You represent one of West Delhi's most respected implant practices — high-value cases, sophisticated patients, a polished environment.
* **Earn from performance.** Beyond a fixed salary, your growth is tied to incentives — the better the clinic runs and converts, the more you make.
* **Future-proof skill set.** Clinic management, patient experience, and operations are transferable across every healthcare business you may ever run or own.

*No prior admin experience required — the right attitude and a BDS matter most. We'll train you.*

* **Direct mentorship** from the founders in clinic management and premium-practice operations.
* A **clear promotion path** into Clinic Manager and operations leadership.
* Hands-on exposure to a modern digital clinic — implants, All-on-X, in-house lab, and an academy.

* The rare chance to grow with a practice that's **expanding across Delhi NCR**.

title: Conversion UX Strategist
description:
Indeed Job Title

**Conversion UX Strategist – Landing Page Strategy & CRO**

Job Description

We are looking for a strategic thinker who can understand a client’s business, audience, product or service, and campaign objectives, then independently develop a complete landing-page strategy focused on conversions.

This is **not a website design or development role**. The primary responsibility is research, conversion planning, content structure, messaging strategy, and presenting a clear plan for client approval before design begins.

You should be able to start with a business objective and build the landing-page journey from scratch—without relying on a ready-made layout, predefined section list, or design reference.

What You’ll Do

**1. Business & Audience Research**

* Understand the client’s business model, products or services, target audience, and campaign objectives.
* Research competitors, customer intent, audience pain points, and reasons prospects may hesitate to convert.
* Identify the key information and value propositions needed to persuade the intended audience.
* Translate business goals into a clear landing-page conversion strategy.

**2. Landing-Page Journey Planning**

* Plan the complete visitor journey, from the first screen to the final call to action.
* Decide the appropriate section structure and information hierarchy based on the campaign goal.
* Determine what visitors need to understand, believe, and see before taking action.
* Define the messaging flow, CTA placement, trust elements, and supporting information.
* Develop the page structure independently rather than waiting for a predefined layout or section list.

**3. Content Strategy & Information Gathering**

* Define the purpose and required content of every section.
* Identify missing business information, proof points, case studies, testimonials, and other assets needed to build a persuasive page.
* Prepare focused questions for clients to gather the information required for the strategy.
* Recommend messaging directions that communicate the client’s value clearly and address customer objections.

**4. Conversion Strategy & Decision-Making**

* Explain the reasoning behind each recommended section and its placement.
* Ensure that the page structure supports the campaign objective and intended conversion action.
* Identify potential friction points that could prevent visitors from enquiring or taking the desired action.
* Recommend relevant trust signals, credibility elements, and calls to action based on audience needs.
* Make strategic decisions independently and justify them using customer intent and conversion principles.

**5. Strategy Documentation & Client Approval**

* Prepare a structured Google Doc for client review and approval before design begins.
* Document the business context, campaign objective, target audience, and primary conversion goal.
* Outline the recommended page journey and section-by-section structure.
* Explain the purpose, content requirements, and information hierarchy of each section.
* Document messaging direction, CTA strategy, trust elements, and credibility requirements.
* List missing information and questions that need client input.
* Present the reasoning behind the overall page strategy in clear, professional language.
* Incorporate client feedback and finalize the plan for approval.

**6. Design Handoff**

* Hand over the approved strategy document for page creation using AI design tools.
* Ensure the resulting page follows the approved structure, messaging direction, and conversion objectives.
* Collaborate with the design or delivery team to clarify strategic decisions when needed.

Role Requirements

* Strong research, analytical thinking, and structured problem-solving.
* Ability to turn business goals and customer insights into a persuasive page journey.
* Clear writing and content-structuring skills.
* Confidence in explaining and defending strategic recommendations.
* Ability to identify missing information and ask clients the right questions.
* Comfort working independently without ready-made templates or detailed instructions.

Experience

Experience in landing-page strategy, conversion rate optimization (CRO), UX strategy, copywriting, digital marketing strategy, or related work is preferred. Candidates should be able to demonstrate how they approach a business problem and develop a conversion-focused page structure from scratch.

Who Can Apply

* Candidates with experience in UX strategy, CRO, landing-page planning, or conversion-focused copywriting.
* Digital marketing strategists who understand campaign goals, audience intent, and lead generation.
* Strong researchers and writers who can independently structure information and build a persuasive customer journey.
* Candidates who can present strategic recommendations clearly to clients.

Skills

* Business and audience research.
* Landing-page journey planning and information architecture.
* Conversion rate optimization principles.
* Content strategy and messaging hierarchy.
* CTA planning and objection handling.
* Trust-building and credibility strategy.
* Competitor and customer-intent analysis.
* Client communication and presentation.
* Structured documentation using Google Docs.
* Critical thinking, independent decision-making, and clear written communication.

**Important:** This role is about deciding what the landing page should communicate, how it should be structured, and why each section matters. Design skills alone are not sufficient; the ability to develop and explain a conversion strategy independently is essential.

title: Premier Service Manager
description:
**Some careers open more doors than others.**


If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further


International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best\-in\-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.


We are currently seeking an experienced person to join the WPB Premier Services Team

**Role Purpose**

* The HSBC Premier offering is one of the world’s first globally linked banking offerings. And of strategic importance for HSBC, the role requires you to be part of premier relationship team across branches
* The role provides dedicated support to a team of Premier Relationship Managers (PRM) in the overall achievement of their income plans (covering acquisition, cross sales, retention, and growth of their portfolios) and day to day contact with their clients in the delivery of the proposition objectives
* In order to deliver client centric service the role also requires you to be a point of contact for clients as and when required and provide customer with a memorable service experience by having a problem solving attitude


In addition, the Premier Officer may provide credit/lending support to the PRM if dictated by market requirements. Building an ongoing relationship based on value and service is critical to being successful in this role.


In order to deliver a high quality service to our highest value personal clients the role holder will need to demonstrate an extensive knowledge of banking products and services across wealth and retail.

**Principal Responsibilities**

**Impact on the business**

* Provide high quality sales support to a team of PRMs mainly focused on getting appointment for PRMs and supporting PRMs in servicing their clients
* Reduce the time spent on process and administrative tasks by PRM to increase PRM’s capacity
* Support PRMs to manage client contact and service, including, in the absence of PRMs, answering client calls, resolving client enquiries on transactional needs and facilitating a smooth hand\-off to the correct channels where appropriate, and managing key event reminders to maintain active client contact
* Provide sales support to PRMs including preparing and completing sales documents, managing data input and report generation, and liaising with support functions to follow through client purchase process requirement

**Clients/Stakeholders**

* Handle client’s enquiries relating to the PRM’s portfolio in a positive, timely, and appropriate manner. Aim to resolve the customer’s queries at the first point of contact and minimise referrals to the PRM for routine transactions.
* Has strong knowledge of the PRM’s portfolio of clients with the support of CRMS and analytical tools
* Proactively responds to client in face\-to\-face and/or telephone settings, updating client profile screens with details of client contact
* Maintains a basic understanding and technical knowledge of relevant products and services
* Support PRMs to execute suitable solutions for product areas responsible for with clients to fulfill their needs and ensure efficient follow up
* Manager the Premier desk (including required contact activity) in the absence of PRM.
* Assist the PRM in organizing events as and when required.
* Refer the attrition cases to PRM immediately
* Coordinate with cross functional teams to manage Premier TAT / customer expectations

**Leadership and teamwork**

* Communicate effectively and works well with other teams within the Branch, Call Center, HTS, and other relevant partners that impact the client’s experience of HSBC; in order to ensure a consistent approach and application of Premier standards
* Efficiently manages time in order to support different PRMs concurrently
* Proactively identifies opportunities/issues and provides feedback to branch management and HTS to improve products and service processes
* Delivering the firm \- Put the client at the heart of our business and deliver joined up services and solutions aligned to customer needs.

**Operational effectiveness and control**

* Ensure all processes and procedures are accurate and in accordance with HSBC Bank policy standards, regulatory requirements, Group Compliance Policy and Internal Controls.
* Comply with local regulations in all aspects of strategy, sales processes, client correspondence, financial promotions, administration, and complaint handling
* Zero discrepancies on documentation for new Liability \& Wealth accounts.
* Ensure 100% accuracy on all KYC and Non KYC documentation and processing of customer instructions
* Ensure all entries captured on WMS are error free and that the entries are reconciled everyday.
* Achieve the operational standards for the business and work within agreed procedures and guidelines \- displaying high levels of integrity at all times
* Maintain awareness of operational risk and minimize the likelihood of it occurring including its identification, assessment, mitigation and control, loss identification and reporting in accordance with section B.1\.2 of the Group Operations FIM.
* Minimum concurrent audit comments and NIL reminders
* Ensure NIL frauds for any cases sourced /handled by the branch.
* Ensure use of RMP for activity management and referring leads to PRMs
* Comply with the applicable laws, regulations, Group and local guidelines related to Sanctions and AML policy of HSBC while undertaking various day to day operations
* Remain alert and promptly report to the Sanctions Officer/ INM FCC office/ Line manager ( As applicable and required by the AML and sanction Policy) if a customer is found to be engaging in sanction evasion activities or violations of AML policy or any other related procedures.
* Understand the legal responsibility to be vigilant for unusual activity and reporting of the unusual activities
* Support the Country or Regional FCC AML Office/ AML Investigations by providing additional information when required
* Responsible for attending and successfully completing the AML and Sanctions related assigned training in the mandated timeframe
* Understanding the consequences of failing to attend or successfully complete the training as mandated by the AML Education Lead FCC;
* Requesting additional AML training that you deem necessary or appropriate to perform your jobs through your entity manager
* Demonstrate an understanding of PEP acceptance, prohibition, CDD \& EDD guidelines in order to ensure that the INM RBWM is fully compliant with the PEP LoBP.
* Understand the relatively high reputational risk that arises from any perceived weaknesses in controls in respect of substantial cash deposits or withdrawals activity, wire transfer, monetary instruments and pouch and mail
* To be aware and Identify high risk indicators for various products and Services offered by INM RBWM example Cash, insurance, credit cards products etc
* Ensure that all records are obtained in respect of INM RBWM customers or New to bank customer for any products and services provided by HSBC are as per the process laid down.
* Must ensure that the prescribed process is being followed while dealing with non HSBC customers request for monetary instruments and wire transfers
* Ensure Adherence to the regulatory guidelines and internal AML \& Sanction Policy of HSBC, which includes pouch and mail, monetary instruments, cash services and payment transparency Line of Business Procedures
* To be aware of AML risk posed by pouch and mail, Monetary instruments, cash services and wire transfer services and should undergo the mandatory training for the same
* Necessary remediation steps needs to be undertaken in case if there is any breach or non\-adherence to the policy laid down in the LoBP
* Must undertake necessary due diligence to ensure that the nature of the transaction is in sync with the customer profile , else raise it to line manager for further clarification
* The staff must be aware of the scope of services of various products and services that are offered and those which are prohibited because of the guidelines laid down in the line of Business procedures and must ensure the same is communicated to customer in a effective and polite manner
* Ensure adequate due diligence is undertaken by the Individual/team to ensure that the nature of the various transactions of wire transfer, cash services, monetary instruments are in sync with customer profile

**Major Challenges**

* Provide high quality support to PRMs
* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures in order to handle client needs
* Proactively help HSBC identify opportunity to improve process efficiencies
* Sensitively redirect clients to the most effective and efficient channel
* Support the client in navigating the channel of their choice (to interact with HSBC) effectively and efficiently
* Ensure the client consistently receives a professional premium service which exceeds their expectations at all times
* Maintain high standards of control and operational practices in line with HSBC’s expectations
* Ensuring the highest standards of customer service in terms of timeliness and customer experience.
* Enhancing customer confidence in the bank’s Global Premier proposition by ensuring the offer of a relevant product suite and supporting this through systematic and regular communication is a key aspect of the role.
* given the growth aspirations of the WM business, the jobholder is to constantly source, develop and grow Premier relationships in a highly competitive market. The said role requires to balance customer servicing activity along with sales acquisition while ensuring the necessary growth in the existing portfolio coupled with minimal attrition.
* Another key challenge is to be able to provide superior service to all walk in customers as per guidelines

**Role Context**


Premier is a key proposition in the bank’s strategy. Over recent years, our business and organisation has made considerable progress both in our performance versus peer group and in our strategic transformation. Over the medium term we have been improving both our profitability and our ability to meet the needs of our target clients.


We have four overriding principles that will apply to the delivery of all propositions, products and services through all channels to all customers at all times:

* We will treat all customers fairly
* We will apply the HSBC Group values and business principles in all of our dealings with customers
* We will meet, or exceed, all local and international laws, regulations, and codes of practice
* We will deliver services to customers in a manner that provides speed, ease, certainty and empathy

**Management of Risk**


Adheres to processes and controls to identify and mitigate risks and ensures timely escalation of control issues and reputation risks.

**Observation of Internal Controls**


Maintains HSBC internal control standards and addresses audit points and/or any issues raised by regulators in a timely manner.

**Role Dimensions**

* Has exceptional and updated knowledge of Banking products, systems and processes.
* Is well organized and depicts professional image
* Displays extra\-ordinary Business focus and customer orientation and provides exemplary service
* Is self\-motivated and has the drive to overachieve on goals and targets set out
* Displays close bonding with immediate team members and skillful association with support group colleagues

**Qualifications**

* Minimum Bachelor’s degree / Graduation with 2 years of experience
* Holistic understanding of the Branch Operations and Processes of the bank
* Sound understanding of the company’s customer service requirements
* **Pro\-tip :** Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage

**Additional Information**

* *Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment, as required.*


You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.


HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
